raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The silver_transactions filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR` silently drops POSTED transactions that arrive more than 26 hours late. From batch 3 onward each batch carries transactions up to about 3 days old (batch 11 ingested 01-16 02:00 holds txns from 01-13 06:00), which explains the drops beyond the REVERSED rows. txn_id is unique across all 4975 rows, so removing the filter creates no duplicates.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
